reviews.x: SOOOOO! I am not a person who normally wrotes reviews, BUT since i've been there , teying to not waste my money and trying to trust another's user review with fear. I decided to do it. This shampoo and conditioners is AMAZING. I loved it, it did leave my hair more shiny, and clearer. Not OMG CLEARER. But Satisfactory clearer. BUT i have been using for a week so maybe at the it will be a lot more shinier and clearer. But what i loved the most is that my hair feels amazing!! If feels , idk soft no

Brings out the color and shine. Also made my hair very soft and bouncy.  The smell is a strong smelling masculine cologne however, I love the smell and  have received so many comments about how good my hair smells from my husband and from my female coworkers. If you are sensitive to scents I would not purchase this.

reviews.t: Really makes a difference in my hair
reviews.x: This set really does make my grays less noticeable and my natural brown deeper and richer looking without having to color! The only thing I would improve is the moisture. I have to use a leave in conditioner or my hair is dry and staticky. Overall though, it is a good product that does what it says it does.

reviews.t: but my hair is curly and this product seemed to make my hair frizzier than I would have liked. Probably works better for
reviews.x: I really did see greater vibrancy in my hair color and it felt soft, but my hair is curly and this product seemed to make my hair frizzier than I would have liked. Probably works better for people who have straight hair.

reviews.t: Not the Brilliant Brunette I Remember
reviews.x: This Shampoo/Conditioner used to smell like heaven.  A light cocoa scent to it.  Just lovely.  I hadn't used it in quite a few years and used to love it, so I thought I would try it again.  The absolute worst scent.  It does a lovely job of adding shine and softness to your hair, but I just can't get over the overpowering scent.  Very disappointed.  I don't know how long ago they changed it, but I won't be buying this again.

I bought the shampoo because I am turning gray and my appt. wasn’t for a week. So I thought maybe it would color some of the gray till my appt.  Well I have heard people talk about their color being brassy and having to go back and have the color fixed. In my mind I had an idea of what this looked like. Well after I was done washing my hair, I can definitely tell you, my hair was brassy.

reviews.t: Brings out the best for brunettes
reviews.x: I've been using these for years and often get compliments on my hair. Compared with other shampoos and conditioners I use, it really brings out the highlights and makes your hair soft and shiny. I don't particularly like the scent but can live with it.

reviews.t: I could tell that this product was going to be bad. It made
reviews.x: I used this shampoo and conditioner one time and it had a strange smell to it. While washing my hair, I could tell that this product was going to be bad. It made .y ahir feel gummy and I could not get a brush through it for many many hours after it was washed with the products. This was last week, and to be honest my hair still has not gone back to normal after using my salon used products. Pray for me.
When it arrived, it wasn’t the shampoo and conditioner were two different types. The shampoo wasn’t the multi-toning. Tried it out and it wasn’t great. Also, the conditioner was damaged.
Love this shampoo and conditioner. Makes my hair shine and smell so good.

reviews.t: Wonderful subtle highlights without any damage to hair
reviews.x: I have natural hair without any chemicals.  My hair is dry and wavy so using hair color results in damage. John Frieda products are remarkable.  Over time, subtle highlights develop and break up my dark brown hair.  Works with my natural color to enhance highlights.  I have used the red conditioner as well to bring out the golden highlights without damage.  The clear is one of the best and most reasonable products just for shine.  I lasts several months and prevents split ends.

I bought this at CVS because I wanted it NOW, lol....love the smell, makes your hair super silky and shinier.  I am trying to transition from blonde to brunette gradually, and it takes some of the brassiness out, and hopefully will help me not have to color as often.  Next time I will purchase it on Amazon because it is cheaper.

reviews.t: Will make most grays honey colored
reviews.x: I didn’t give this shampoo more stars because it smells very strongly. I never got quite used to it. I wish it was less perfumed. I am trying the red version now and it smells even stronger. :-(  It does what it says it does. Will also color some of grays to a honey brown which I liked.
The smell is great! But the shampoo seemed to drybput my hair and so I used up my conditioner a lot faster. Didn't notice any difference with it. So I'm back to using Suave.

reviews.t: Did not receive what I was supposed to.
reviews.x: A little upset....this was sold as a set 1 Shampoo &1 Conditioner BUT, I received 2 Shampoos 🤔😒 not quite sure how to get a response from anyone to fix the problem.
Does beautiful on my hair. Love the scent it leaves too 😊😊😊
Love love love this shampoo and conditoner!

My biggest problem is that I live in a community that uses harsh water. Thus, it is difficult to find a shampoo and conditioner that can break through it and actually brighten and smooth the hair. This set is one of the only ones out of MANY, that makes my brunette hair smooth and shiny. Try it if you have well water or use a community well that is supposedly filtered.

This came leaked all over. Very disappointing. So much wasted product. I will never order stuff like this without knowing for sure that it is sealed. This was not sealed. What a mess! I should have known better and get this at a store.
I can’t bring myself to use this every day due to the hideous odor of it.. it smells like bad old lady perfume... so I can’t comment on how it works in color because I only use it like once a week.
This until recently was my standard shampoo and conditioner for well over 10 years. There’s actually a Better product out there but you really can’t go wrong with THIS John Frieda combination

reviews.t: Smells good but hard to wash out
reviews.x: Smells good and seems to help hair color stay vibrant but it takes a lot more rinsing than other brands and if you don’t rinse long enough your hair will be sticky.

reviews.t: Completely happy, I use it everyday
reviews.x: This picture they showed on review is not actual product. I use The John Frieda for Burnett's in a brown tube. It is my daily shampoo & conditioner.  I LOVE IT!
Love everything about the shampoo and conditioner. Had read reviews that it doesn’t smell good, but I personally love the scent. Will buy again.

reviews.t: Great brand and leaves hair feeling soft not stickey
reviews.x: Great brand and leaves hair feeling soft not stickey. Holds hair color longer. Containers are toiletry bag & gym bag friendly!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the shampoo and conditioner add shine, softness, and bring out highlights or color.
The scent is polarizing: some love it and get compliments, while others find it too strong or unpleasant.
Some reviewers report the product leaves hair dry, frizzy, or staticky, especially for curly or dry hair.
A few reviewers had problems with the product received, such as wrong or damaged items.
Some reviewers mention it can turn gray hair brassy or honey-colored rather than as expected.
